tagline: Drag a path from the yurt to the farm. The file keeps your best.
description:
Your best score is saved — share the GIF and the high score goes with it. Press Invite in the bar above and a friend sees the score you have reached; each of you plays your own valley.

People live in yurts. Farms need tending. Drag with a finger or the left mouse button from a yurt onto a farm; the red grid (or a right-click) rubs a path out. Score is settlers plus animals. You get a handful of path tiles each year — spend them well. Pause to think; you can still draw.

An unofficial port of Tiny Yurts by burntcustard (John), js13k 2023 4th place. The farms, the yurts, and the animals are his. This copy makes a phone drag actually draw a path.
